measurement_caveats: Historical names are reconstructed from retained input replay. Unretained branches cannot be reconstructed from scalar counts.
A replay stamp execution counts actions in that tape, not historical search executions; route_action_end_frame is not cumulative emulator work.
Old Ridley defeat count used the wrong bit. No recovered Metroid tape verifies a boss defeat; the old aggregate cannot prove absence across every branch.
Met27 champion replay has Ice Beam, not Long Beam. Historical scalar item counts cannot distinguish them.
Old retained-map-cell counts and current cumulative observed-map-cell counters have different scopes.
Wily 4 tape is a replay compatibility fixture, never a supplied seed for fresh search.
Registered 008 diagnostic uses reused historical seeds and differs from the historical replay machinery; it is not fresh validation.
Named-progress v2 latches transient Tourian defeat/escape states without adding search observations. Old v1 reports lacking these fields remain unavailable.
All 17 retained tapes were rerun twice with the corrected probe, rather than adjusting old timestamps arithmetically. Serialized snapshot hashes change with the new observation schema.
The live union and every witness are separate scopes. Route frames exclude genesis setup; physical frames and setup are explicitly reported by the probe.
